title: AI assistant
body_text:
To assist you in performing the tasks, you will receive the help of an AI assistant. The AI has access to the same source image as you do, and will provide a suggestion on the decision to be made. Please note that the AI might make mistakes, and that the ultimate decision is always your responsability.

In addition, you will have access to a justification of the AI's prediction. It will highlight areas of the image which were important for the prediction. Green areas highlight zones which are leaning towards the decision YES, and red areas highlight zones which are leaning towards the decision NO.

Here is an example of AI prediction for the search of the pattern below.



Please make sure you understand how the justification works before clicking on the button below.
